comment: Jubaku inflicts the Paralysis debuff. If the effect fails to land,
recast will be delayed based on the configured retry duration.
when: hasSpell('Jubaku: San', 'Jubaku: Ni', 'Jubaku: Ichi') and canUseSpell(spell)
(findUsableItem('Toolbag (Jusa)') and freeInventorySlots() > 1 and useItem(me) and wait(1)) or \
(findUsableItem('Toolbag (Cho)') and freeInventorySlots() > 1 and useItem(me) and wait(1))
